description: email.rs line 1429 emits format!("{call_id}-implicit") as the call-id for the implicit Email/set invocation. RFC 8621 §6.1 is explicit: 'both with the same method call id'. The implicit Email/set MUST use the parent call's call-id verbatim. Clients that use methodResponses correlation by call-id will fail to match the implicit response.
title: Email/copy implicit Email/set uses wrong call-id
